item.title: How to Audit and Correct Financial Statements in Microsoft Excel Using AI
item.description:
How to Audit and Correct Financial Statements in Microsoft Excel Using AI

Financial statements often contain hundreds of rows of data. Even a minor typing error in a balance sheet or cash book can result in incorrect financial reporting. Manually verifying every calculation is time-consuming and prone to human error.

This article demonstrates how AI can assist in auditing Microsoft Excel financial statements by validating calculations, detecting inconsistencies, and generating corrected reports automatically.

item.title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Combat GST Fraud: Challenges, Solutions, and the Future of Tax Administration
item.description:
Using Artificial Intelligence to Combat GST Fraud

The Goods and Services Tax (GST) is one of the most significant tax reforms in India. It replaced multiple indirect taxes with a unified taxation system, simplifying compliance and improving transparency. However, the scale and complexity of GST have also created opportunities for sophisticated tax fraud.

Fake invoices, shell companies, fraudulent Input Tax Credit (ITC) claims, refund fraud, circular trading, and tax evasion continue to challenge tax authorities. Traditional audit methods are no longer sufficient to detect these frauds efficiently.
